import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

private const val MOD: Long = 1_000_000_007L

fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long): Long {
    var base = a % MOD
    var exp = e
    var res = 1L
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp and 1L) != 0L) res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp = exp shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val k = st.nextToken().toInt()

    if (k == 1) {
        // Only permutation where max is n is [n, ...]; all others are bad
        var fact = 1L
        for (i in 2..n) fact = (fact * i) % MOD
        val good = (n - 1 + MOD) % MOD
        val ans = (fact - good + MOD) % MOD
        println(ans)
        return
    }

    val maxN = n
    val fact = LongArray(maxN + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(maxN + 1)
    fact[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..maxN) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    invFact[maxN] = modPow(fact[maxN], MOD - 2)
    for (i in maxN downTo 1) {
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD
    }

    fun comb(a: Int, b: Int): Long {
        if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0L
        return (((fact[a] * invFact[b]) % MOD) * invFact[a - b]) % MOD
    }

    var ans = 0L
    val limit = n - 1
    val maxI = n / k
    for (i in 0..maxI) {
        val sign = if (i % 2 == 0) 1L else MOD - 1
        val choose = comb(limit - i * (k - 1), i)
        val term = choose * fact[n - i * k] % MOD
        ans += sign * term % MOD
        if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD
    }

    val total = fact[n]
    val bad = (total - ans + MOD) % MOD
    println(bad)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

private const val MOD: Long = 1_000_000_007L

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val k = st.nextToken().toInt()

    if (k == 1) {
        // Only permutation where function returns n is [1..n]
        val fact = factorial(n)
        val ans = (fact - 1 + MOD) % MOD
        println(ans)
        return
    }

    val fact = LongArray(n + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(n + 1)
    fact[0] = 1
    for (i in 1..n) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], MOD - 2)
    for (i in n downTo 1) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD

    fun comb(a: Int, b: Int): Long {
        if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0
        return fact[a] * invFact[b] % MOD * invFact[a - b] % MOD
    }

    var ans = 0L
    val maxI = n / k
    for (i in 1..maxI) {
        val sign = if (i % 2 == 1) 1L else -1L
        val c = comb(n - (i - 1) * (k - 1), i)
        val term = c * fact[n - i] % MOD
        ans = (ans + sign * term + MOD) % MOD
    }

    println(ans)
}

private fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long): Long {
    var base = a % MOD
    var exp = e
    var res = 1L
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp and 1L == 1L) res = res * base % MOD
        base = base * base % MOD
        exp = exp shr 1
    }
    return res
}

private fun factorial(n: Int): Long {
    var res = 1L
    for (i in 2..n) res = res * i % MOD
    return res
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

private const val MOD: Long = 1_000_000_007L

fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long): Long {
    var base = a % MOD
    var exp = e
    var res = 1L
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp and 1L) != 0L) res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp = exp shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val k = st.nextToken().toInt()

    val fact = LongArray(n + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(n + 1)
    fact[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..n) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], MOD - 2)
    for (i in n downTo 1) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD

    fun comb(nn: Int, rr: Int): Long {
        if (rr < 0 || rr > nn) return 0L
        return fact[nn] * invFact[rr] % MOD * invFact[nn - rr] % MOD
    }

    var ans = 0L
    val maxI = minOf(k, n - 1)
    for (i in 0..maxI) {
        val c = comb(n - 1, i)
        val sign = if (i % 2 == 0) 1L else MOD - 1
        ans = (ans + sign * c) % MOD
    }
    ans = ans * fact[n] % MOD
    val total = fact[n]
    val res = (total - ans + MOD) % MOD
    println(res)
}
